title: Spicy Malaysian Noodle Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry made with Malaysian noodles, rice, and a hint of nutty flavor.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
Toast the peanuts in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onions, carrots, and bell peppers. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cooked noodles, soy sauce, and spicy peanut sauce. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the toasted peanuts and chopped cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over the cooked rice.
